_comment: Model catalogue. Data, not code, for three reasons: (1) model ids and pricing change faster than releases, (2) under IaC this becomes an SSM Parameter the CDK stack writes, so operators retune routing without a deploy, (3) adding a model is a config change a non-engineer can review. Verify ids with: aws bedrock list-foundation-models --region ap-southeast-2

models._disabled_reason: No qualifying scorecard on any task, and excluded on LATENCY rather than quality: p50 11.8s / p90 19.9s against the production 20s client timeout, with 9 of 98 plan calls over the ceiling (2026-08-28). It was `enabled` and second preference for generate_plan, so a Nova Pro outage failed over to a model already documented as unfit -- and because it declares both the quality and fast tiers, the cheapest-first fallback in route() made it a candidate for EVERY task. Re-enable only with a scorecard and a latency measurement under the ceiling.

scorecards._comment: Measured evidence, per model per task. A model is eligible for a task only with an entry here that meets the floor; see tests/test_multimodel.py, which fails the build if a routable model has no scorecard for a task it could serve. Recording the guardrail version matters: an intent score is a measurement of the classifier AND the policy in front of it, and version 2 unblocked cases version 1 refused.

generate_plan._source: evals/run_meal_plan.py, 11 cases, three clean reps each, paced

_unscored_tasks._comment: Tasks no eval measures, named rather than hidden. The test treats these as accepted gaps; deleting a task from here without adding a scorecard makes the build fail, which is the point.
_unscored_tasks.repair_plan: Exercised INSIDE the meal-plan eval -- repair fires during those runs and its output is scored through the same invariants -- but never scored on its own. A repair-specific regression would show up only as a lower meal-plan score.
_unscored_tasks.generate_prose: No eval measures prose at all. Legacy 5.6 (subjective quality scoring) is unchecked, so prose is routed to models nothing has scored for prose. Bounded by construction rather than by measurement: the node rejects money, rejects unknown placeholders, verifies the cheapest claim against retrieved records, and degrades to the structured payload on any failure.
